rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for an excited state of intense happiness.

example.english: I was filled with euphoria when I received the gift.
example.traditional: 收到份禮物嗰刻，我真係興奮到瞓唔着。
example.jyutping: sau1 dou2 fan6 lai5 mat6 go2 hak1 ngo5 zan1 hai6 hing1 fan5 dou3 fan3 m4 zoek6

rows.note: Use this for exceptionally overwhelming or ecstatic happiness rather than ordinary excitement.

example.english: When our team won the championship, the whole city was swept up in euphoria.
example.traditional: 我哋隊贏咗冠軍嗰一刻，全城都陷入狂喜。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 deoi6 jeng4 zo2 gun3 gwan1 go2 jat1 hak1 cyun4 sing4 dou1 haam6 jap6 kong4 hei2
